joints.attack: Off-by-one length, truncated UTF-8 or newline, record-count mismatch, duplicate keys, nonfinite JSON, boolean counts
Absolute/traversal paths, symlink final and parent components, nonregular files, giant metadata lengths
Pass with hidden suffix or inline mismatch; failure with acknowledged prefix mismatch; absent prefix with alleged zero children

blind_derivation: For bytes b, prefix n, valid count c: hash only b[:n], require length >= n and complete strict JSONL exactly c records. Passed final requires no suffix and inline==prefix. Failed final can retain unacknowledged suffix but cannot validate its contents as acknowledged.
